card.name: Spots just before a number or statistic
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces or digits right before a number in study results, such as after RR or HR, in a range dash, or after CYP3A. The next word is often a value or the word positive.

modes.label: Before a statistic value
modes.description: A space after RR or HR or CI, just before the numeric value.

modes.label: Inside a range or list of numbers
modes.description: A dash or comma between numbers in a range or dose list.

modes.label: Inside enzyme names
modes.description: The final 4 in CYP3A4 before the word substrate.

card.writes: It promotes the word positive in its forms and suppresses odd foreign-language pieces, so it adds little that is clear.
card.plain: It fires at small gaps right before a number in study results, like after RR or in a range.
